events.why: step 64: the lab gate asks for five registered species, 3/5 after the tutorial: two new ones here in Wild Zone 1 before leaving, Scatterbug (on the road at 100 from the far gate) and Mareep (in the grass right of the road at 60), so the gate's scene finds 5/5 (user, 2026-11-13). From Taunie's rocks it first takes the route measured by hand on console B (2026-11-16): L, left 900 ms off the rocks, the start checked by the map pin at the rocks, (476, 224) in every run there (the marker read of 120 to 135 only a cross-check: in French, console B 2026-11-17 02:41, its digits did not read in 24 looks with the pin at the rocks), then the marker walk to 103 or less, 8 s at most, to the plaza at 100 (the rocks hide the marker), and fails there, before any catch, when either does not get there. From there it runs plza/autostory's patrol, which passed about 11 times on console B on 2026-11-14 from the road at 127: 100, 60, 100, 60, ... (walking to 100 and back brings Pokemon back at 60); 10 visits, 10 minutes, 12 throws at most. At each stop it sweeps the camera for the lock-on brackets, holds ZL on the nearest, throws at the nearest plate not caught, again at once after a miss that locks on again, and weakens a target that broke out. The party bar's filled slots decide, read before the first stop and after each stop that threw: 5 means done, since every catch is a new species and the "Registered!" banner is missed at times (console B 2026-11-14 19:36: Mareep in the party, no banner seen). Unread, the banners' and plates' tally decides.

metadata.source: console B recording, 2026-11-08/09: played step by step from a new game. Ends at the last catch: each catch autosaves, and the 2026-11-14 run logs showed that autosave after the catches, logged at the far-gate walk (zone_1_to_far_gate) on plza/autostory, so 03.08 is split there (03.08b walks out). Short on species, it fails inside the zone. Its start save is 03.07's after_catches autosave: runs 2 and 3 on console B, 2026-11-16, reloaded the latest save at Taunie's rocks inside the zone. Start signature: the lead's panel shows there (it_0308 frames, console B 2026-11-16), and the party bar shows 3: the starter and the tutorial's two catches. The lead's panel alone does not tell the zone from the street: a save on the street past 03.09 read "in a wild zone" (console B, 2026-11-16 18:34), and 03.08 ran as a no-op there; its party (5) tells it apart. No menu save at its end: 03.08b's first step walks back to the road from wherever the last catch was.
